text: What to do if your girlfriend has fictional character crush and that bothers you? I received a very original and unusual relationship question from one of my subscribers. So let's go straight to it. Hey man, my girlfriend and I are having an issue regarding fictional character crushes and it's been really weighing on me. A while ago, I asked her a question. If all of your fictional character crushes were lined up, would you choose them over me? Great question, right? She replied, if I see an open shot, I'm going to take it. That response has been stuck in my head ever since and I haven't been able to stop thinking about it. Well, who would? About three days later, she told me that she had changed her mind. She said she would stop liking those characters for me, apologized and said she regretted what she said because she hadn't really thought about the question at the time and didn't realize how it would make me feel. However, some of her actions since then have felt like they contradict what she told me. For example, this month she bought a body pillow of her own original character and that character happens to be exactly her type. When we talked about it, she explained that she admires the character in a way a kid admires a superhero like Batman and that she wouldn't be weird about it. On top of that, she does you-me shipping, which is when you ship yourself or a version of yourself with another character. This makes me feel really insecure and uncomfortable. Last night, she showed me a drawing of her ship and even though she said it wasn't literally her, the character looked like her and the character she shipped with had her initial on his neck. At first, I thought he was talking about a ship like a vessel, but I guess this ship means like a shipping between her and some character. We've both said that celebrity crushes feel weird to us, but we have completely different views on fictional character crushes. I see it as having wandering eyes, while she doesn't see it that way at all. I really just need advice on what to do and what would be the best step forward because I want to keep her as my girlfriend, but I just want to get this obstacle out of the way so we can both be happy together. Okay, quite an unusual question, right? So this is what I wrote. Hey man, thank you for your question. This is actually quite an original and unusual situation. First of all, I do think it is a good sign that when your girlfriend realized her answer about the fictional character crush made you uncomfortable, she apologized and said she regretted what she said. At the very least, this shows empathy and that your feelings do matter to her. That's important and worth acknowledging. Now, regarding Yumi shipping and fictional character crushes in general. I'll be honest, I'm not very well-versed in that world. But in my opinion, if this is the only real issue in your relationship and everything else is going well, then it's probably not a major problem by itself. A lot of people have unusual or niche interests and hobbies. As long as her real-life actions show empathy, respect, love, and trust towards you, that matters much more. That being said, if the Yumi shipping and fictional character crushes genuinely bother you, I would not recommend burying this deep inside yourself. You are in a relationship and if something makes you feel insecure or uncomfortable, it is something you should talk about. Explain it to her in a calm way. You can say that you realize that it may sound weird that you can be insecure about silly stuff like fictional characters, but for you, it is still important. Then you can propose a solution. For example, that you two can enjoy those fictional worlds, but maybe without Yumi shipping or drawing yourself into those scenarios. The goal is to find a compromise. Have a proper conversation about it. You are in a relationship, so you should talk about things that bother you. And if she listens to you and genuinely tries to adjust because it bothers you, that would be a very good sign that your relationship is on the right track. I hope this helps. All right, guys, thank you very much. I hope you found this story entertaining. You can share your thoughts about the situation in the comments. Thanks a lot and bye.
